patch_description: Combines the best-performing components from prior generations: (1) beam search with adaptive width and diversity-preserving pruning (keep top-k by cost plus a few divergent children), (2) full-lookahead greedy multi-start constructions with random tie-breaking to generate diverse candidates, and (3) simulated-annealing local search with greedy insertion intensification on the top candidates. Diversity in both beam pruning and construction seeds prevents prefix convergence, which empirically drove the beam-search variants to the best scores (makespan 275 vs 309 for pure greedy). Time budget raised to ~28s per workload with construction phase capped at 50%.
